g.text: tenantId — required on every applicable table (multi-tenant scoping, Master Spec A4)
PK = primary key FK = foreign key UK = unique constraint UK* = composite unique (part of the idempotency mechanism — see 10-idempotency-concurrency.svg) ? = nullable
